note: Renewing abroad cost 100 dollars a passport in the Ministry of Justice's 2021-22 campaign in Portugal, the United Kingdom and South Korea, as TATOLI reported on 10 February 2022. The fee at home isn't read from a current source: the only figures found (50 dollars in 10 days, 75 in 3, 100 in 24 hours) come from a 2017 report whose page refuses the request. The passport is valid at most 5 years, under the Passports Regime (Decree-Law 52/2016) as Decree-Law 23/2023 recites it.

sources.title: Jornal da República, Série I, N.º 15A (2023), Decreto-Lei n.º 23/2023, Prorrogação extraordinária do prazo de validade dos passaportes eletrónicos de Timor-Leste, preamble
sources.said: Decreto-Lei n.º 52/2016, de 28 de dezembro, que aprova o Novo Regime Jurídico de Passaportes,alterado pelo Decreto-Lei n.º 12/2017, de 29 de março. O referido diploma legal prevê que o passaporte eletrónico de Timor-Leste possa ser emitido com um prazo máximo de validade de cinco anos, o qual é improrrogável.

sources.title: TATOLI, Renewal of Timorese passport abroad brings $220.400.00 to the state treasury (10 February 2022)
sources.said: From the renewal passports, Portugal recorded 202 people, the United Kingdom recorded 656 people, Northern Ireland recorded 200 people and South Korea recorded 1,146 people with a total of 2,204 passport renewals. Each Passport unit is paid $ 100, therefore from the 2204 person, DNICRC collected $220,400 to the state treasury
